relation.rationale: Difference in the final consonant cluster (ch vs h) representing the same grammatical form.
The difference is the use of an apostrophe to indicate elision (d' for der), which is a graphic/orthographic variation.
Difference is the use of a diacritic (aͤ) versus a plain letter (a) in the same word form.
Difference in the spelling of the negation particle (nicht vs nit), same grammatical form.
Difference between 's' and 't' in the same grammatical form (sommerstagen vs sommertagen).

The difference between 'zeit' and 'zelt' involves the substitution of 'i' for 'e', which is a spelling variation (likely a typo or dialectal variant) rather than a standard orthographic convention like u/v or i/j.
Difference between long s (ſ) and short s (s) in the same word.
Difference in the use of the long s (ſ) versus the short s (s) in the word 'für'.

The primary difference is the use of the Tironian note (gedẽk) versus the full spelling (gedenk), which is a graphic/orthographic variant. The presence of the apostrophe in some readings is a secondary punctuation difference, but the core lexical item variation is orthographic.
